lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 요즘 힘들어 보여요. 무슨 일 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, you look tired lately. What's wrong?
lines.beaver_roman: minsu ssi, yojeum himdeureo boyeoyo. museun il isseoyo?
lines.learner: 선배, 면접에서 또 떨어졌어요. 너무 속상해요.
lines.en: I failed another interview. I'm so upset.
lines.roman: seonbae, myeonjeobeseo tto tteoreojeosseoyo. neomu soksanghaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: You must have been upset. How are you doing now?
lines.en: It's hard now, but I think I was just unlucky.

lines.beaver: 그래요. 사실 나도 실패를 많이 했어요.
lines.beaver_en: I see. Actually, I've failed a lot too.
lines.beaver_roman: geuraeyo. sasil nado silpareul mani haesseoyo.
lines.en: Really? But you're a successful person.

lines.beaver: 하하, 첫 회사는 일 년 만에 망했어요.
lines.beaver_en: Haha, my first company went under in a year.
lines.beaver_roman: haha, cheot hoesaneun il lyeon mane manghaesseoyo.
lines.en: I didn't know. How did you get through it?

lines.beaver_en: I thought of failure as a good experience.
lines.learner: 저도 이번 경험에서 배운 게 있어요.
lines.en: I learned something from this experience too.
lines.roman: jeodo ibeon gyeongheomeseo baeun ge isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 적어도 다음 준비는 더 잘할 수 있죠.
lines.beaver_en: Right. At least you can prepare better next time.
lines.beaver_roman: majayo. jeogeodo daeum junbineun deo jalhal su itjyo.
lines.learner: 네, 세상은 넓으니까 기회는 또 오겠죠.
lines.en: Yes, the world is big, so chances will come again.
lines.roman: ne, sesangeun neolbeunikka gihoeneun tto ogetjyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼요. 붙으면 새 회사에 빨리 적응해야죠.
lines.beaver_en: Of course. Once you pass, adapt quickly to the new company.
lines.beaver_roman: geureomyo. buteumyeon sae hoesae ppalli jeogeunghaejyo.
lines.learner: 저는 적응이 느려서 그게 좀 걱정이에요.
lines.en: I adapt slowly, so I'm a bit worried about that.
lines.roman: jeoneun jeogeungi neuryeoseo geuge jom geokjeongieyo.

lines.beaver: 천천히 하면 돼요. 그런데 민수 씨는 운명을 믿어요?
lines.beaver_en: Just take it slow. By the way, do you believe in fate?
lines.beaver_roman: cheoncheonhi hamyeon dwaeyo. geureonde minsu ssineun unmyeongeul mideoyo?
lines.learner: 조금요. 그래도 제 노력을 더 믿고 싶어요.
lines.en: A little. But I'd rather believe in my own effort.
lines.roman: jogeumyo. geuraedo je noryeogeul deo mitgo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver: 하하, 좋네요. 민수 씨는 뭘 제일 중요하게 생각해요?
lines.beaver_en: Haha, nice. What do you think matters most?
lines.beaver_roman: haha, jonneyo. minsu ssineun mwol jeil jungyohage saenggakaeyo?
lines.en: I believe things work out if you try hard.

lines.beaver: 멋진 생각이에요. 언젠가 꼭 꿈을 이룰 거예요.
lines.beaver_en: That's a great thought. You'll reach your dream someday.
lines.beaver_roman: meotjin saenggagieyo. eonjenga kkok kkumeul irul geoyeyo.
lines.learner: 고마워요, 선배. 이제 마음이 좀 가벼워졌어요.
lines.en: Thank you. I feel a bit lighter now.
lines.roman: gomawoyo, seonbae. ije maeumi jom gabyeowojeosseoyo.
